spec.title: LRU Cache
taskFacts: Implement a cache initialized with a positive capacity, supporting get(key) and put(key, value).
get returns the value when present and -1 otherwise; successful access makes that key recently used.
put updates or adds a key and makes it recently used; if the cache grows past capacity, remove the least recently used key.
Both get and put must take O(1) average time.
spec.timeComplexityInstruction: O(1) average time per get and put
constraints: At most 2 * 10^5 calls to get and put.
get and put require O(1) average time.

examples.explanation: Reading key 1 refreshes it; inserting key 3 then evicts key 2.
